prompt: High-fidelity Mobile UI screen for MY AUTO GUIDE - Live GPS Navigation & Speed Camera Telemetry HUD. Floating Top Turn-by-Turn Maneuver Card with heavy glass blur: curved arrow icon 'Giro a la derecha en Av. Las Palmas', remaining distance 350m, ETA 18 min (12.4 km). Floating Live Speed HUD circular gauge showing 68 km/h in glowing cyan next to speed limit circle badge 60 km/h with flashing amber warning border. Map pins showing: Speed Camera Radar (Fotomulta 300m ahead), Police Checkpoint (Retén vial), Traffic Slowdown zone. Bottom Floating Quick Report Radial Menu with icons to report: Camera, Hazard, Police, Accident. Bottom route overview pill with 'Terminar Ruta' red button and 'Rutas Alternas' glass button. Typography Outfit.
